title: Acceptance bound for an incorrect matrix product
statement: Let $A,B,C$ be square matrices of the same finite size over the field with two elements. If $C\ne AB$, then a uniformly random vector $x$ over that field satisfies $Cx=A(Bx)$ in every coordinate with probability at most $1/2$.
hypotheses_covered: $n$ is a natural number specifying the matrix size
$A,B,C$ are matrices over the field with two elements
